Many local scholars and learned people who are aware of this situation have stated through reference to religious texts (I cannot remember exactly which ones as I am not myself a scholar) that the leading of salah by such an individual described above is makhrooh tehreemi. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 25208 Country: India Title: My question is, A non-muslim friend has donated a Aqua Guard (Water Purifier) to our Masjid. Can we use this in our Masjid. Is it allowable as per the shariah guidelines or not? Can we accept donations from non-muslims friends to Madarsa and Masjid. Kindly reply as soon as possible. Question: Assalam O Alaikum, My question is, A non-muslim friend has donated a Aqua Guard (Water Purifier) to our Masjid. Can we use this in our Masjid. Is it allowable as per the shariah guidelines or not? Can we accept donations from non-muslims friends to Madarsa and Masjid. Kindly reply as soon as possible. Answer ID: 25208 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1781/1307/H=1431) By accepting the donation for the mosque if there is no fear of evils, and he contributed it only thinking it good and virtuous deed then it is allowable to use it in the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
